verdict.rationale: Storing SSH keys in a biometric-protected secure enclave is a fair question for an iOS terminal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions SSH key management, Secure Enclave, Keychain or Face ID/Touch ID protection. The only related note is that in-app commands share the sandbox and can read its credential files, which describes file-based storage, not hardware-backed protection.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics
